obligations.note: PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and payments.privileged_idle_minutes are set to 16, above the required maximum of 15, so a privileged session can remain accepted after 15 idle minutes. EXC-0189 is scoped to mortgage.session, and EXC-0141 (payments.session) expired on 2026-09-05, before review on 2026-10-05.
Ticket CHG-24519 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-02, before review, and its components payments.policy and payments.controls-data cover both changed paths.
Sofia Santos, a payments change approver and not the author, gave a code_review approval of commit 31160f7a329c58840ec067288001c73614a75262.
The change is a single commit, and the code_review and control_owner approvals both name that head commit.

records/ci/run.json shows the payments suite succeeding on the head commit, and the JUnit report has 172 tests with no failures, errors, or skips, including test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy.
The touched components payments.policy and payments.controls-data are not marked security_sensitive, so a security review is not required.
controls/payments/policy-params.json is a protected path, and Rachel Stein, a control owner on controls-office rather than the author's payments-eng team, approved the head commit.
The ticket type is standard and the change record is not an emergency, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The change relies on EXC-0189, which is approved and unexpired but scoped to mortgage.session, not payments.policy. EXC-0141 is for payments.session, expired on 2026-09-05, and is limited to batch reconciliation service-account sessions, so it does not authorize a global 16-minute idle timeout.
The acceptance-ledger covers for payments, audit, routes, underwriting, and approvals are not modified, so that earlier evidence has not lapsed.

summary: The change sets Payments' privileged idle interval to 16 minutes in both policy.py and policy-params.json, which violates SES-1's 15-minute maximum. The cited exception EXC-0189 covers Mortgage sessions, not Payments, and the Payments session exception EXC-0141 expired before this review. Ticket approval, independent code review, commit coverage, CI on the head commit, and control-owner approval are present, and the change is not emergency or security-sensitive. Because the idle-timeout obligation is violated and no in-scope unexpired exception excuses it, the change is rejected.
